answer: Resist sybils with cedar roots, karst conduits, and marble weight. Each identity plants one cedar whose roots must draw from distinct peers; roots tapping the same source graft into one tree, so fakes share one tree and one share. Influence travels through karst conduits of fixed flow: fakes crowded into one conduit split the same flow, adding none. Each bond is a marble block in its conduit. If one resident cheats, its conduit collapses and crushes every block inside, multiplied by the block count, so N fakes forfeit close to N squared in blocks while a lone honest identity stakes one block.
